nodes.value: Send articles, web pages and PDFs from this Mac to your Daylight: drop them on this window or the Dock icon, use the Share menu in Safari, Finder or Preview, or the Safari extension.
On your Daylight, open Daylight Share and choose This is my Daylight. It shows a QR code and a 28-character pairing code.
Everything you send is end-to-end encrypted with a key from that code. Items travel through the free ntfy.sh relay (or your own), which only sees ciphertext.
Type or paste the code (or a daylightshare:// link):

nodes.label: Paste from the clipboard and pair
